ideas.idea: Remove or fix the Product JSON-LD on /shop because 'Bilge pump' doesn't match any single product on the page
ideas.why: The JSON-LD in shop/+page.svelte names a product the page doesn't show, so it's a real mismatch. It's a separate point from the known missing offers/review/aggregateRating.

ideas.idea: Put the delivery terms in normal page text instead of data-nosnippet, or state what 'next day' depends on
ideas.why: data-nosnippet on the delivery notice is a deliberate choice, and the report itself says to leave it if deliberate.

ideas.idea: Give each product its own page, linked and listed in the sitemap
ideas.why: /shop only has a sentence listing bilge pumps, cleats and rope with nothing to click, so separate linkable pages would give crawlers and users something to find.

ideas.idea: Add a viewport meta tag to src/app.html
ideas.why: The tag is missing as stated, but it's a standard mobile fix that applies to almost any site and has little effect on discovery.

ideas.idea: Wrap content in a <main> landmark instead of a bare <div>
ideas.why: It's accurate, since app.html uses a bare div, but it's a standard structural tweak with little effect on how the site is found.

ideas.idea: Add a description to /search or leave it as is
ideas.why: The report itself says no change is needed because /search is deliberately noindex.
